column1: # ⚠ THE NINE WARNINGS EVERY MANUAL IN SCOPE EARNS, and they are furniture rather than

#   RawBlockSkipped 8   @tex blocks in common-macros.itexi (5), macros.itexi (1) and
#                       cyrillic.itexi (1) -- raw TeX, which this chain has no typesetter
#                       for and renders nothing for, by design. ⚠ The eighth belongs to
#                       whichever of the two @tex blocks in common-macros.itexi the manual
#                       reaches; every manual reaches the same set.
#   Macro           1   common-macros.itexi:330 defines @macro cindex over the built-in
#                       @cindex; the package keeps the built-in and says so.
# Anything ABOVE that floor is this manual's own, and is explained below.
# learning -- MEASURED at wave LD5 (2026-08-19) and READ before freezing.
#   Emit 1      an @math use in common-notation.itely rendered as styled text; this chain
#               has no mathematical typesetter. Content present, not lost.
#   Include 1   Image 'pictures/context-example', named by @sourceimage at
#               fundamental.itely:1450.
#     ⚠ UPSTREAM SHIPS ONLY THE .eps AND BUILDS THE .png. The .eps IS in the mirror, so
#     this is a build product missing exactly as essay's bibliography files are, and it is
#     baselined for the same reason. Its alternate text is used instead.
#     ⚠ BEFORE ANYONE "FIXES" THIS: the very same .eps resolves perfectly well for the
#     Notation Reference. There it is reached by \epsfile from INSIDE a music snippet, so
#     the ENGINE reads it rather than the image resolver -- and the engine reads EPS. Two
#     different consumers of one file, and only one of them can take it.
# The other five pictures this manual names -- the Frescobaldi_* screenshots -- are in the
# mirror and are placed. 253 snippets asked for and 253 engraved, which is the largest
